body: The pleats hold their shape well even after a full day at the office, and the taupe is a genuinely wearable neutral that goes with almost everything in my closet. I got the S and the waist sits comfortably without needing a belt, though the wool blend does mean I have to be careful about ironing temperature. Drape through the leg is soft rather than stiff, which I wasn't sure about from photos alone.

Ordered my usual M and the length is perfect with low heels, but the waistband has a little extra room even with the pleats gathered. Not enough to size down for, just noting it. Fabric feels more expensive than the price suggests, soft wool blend with a slight structure to it.

The wool blend feels good against the skin and the taupe color matched what I saw online. My complaint is the pleats lose their crisp look after sitting for a couple hours, so I find myself pressing them before most wears. Fit in the L was true to size through the hip.
Flattering silhouette, taupe reads warm not grey.

I own two other wide-leg trousers from other stores and these have the best waist construction of the three, the pleats actually stay put through movement instead of flattening within a week. Went with my usual M and it matches how the last pair from here fit. Wool blend doesn't pill after a few wears which was my main worry going in.

On my feet a lot for work and these move well without feeling restrictive at the hip. Sized up to L since I prefer a looser waist and that ended up being the right call for me, would be slightly small in M. Pockets are deep enough to actually hold my phone, which is rare for trousers like this.
Soft, drapes nicely, true to size for me.

I usually wear a M comfortably in wide-leg trousers from other brands and this M was noticeably tight through the waist, could not sit down without the pleats pulling open awkwardly. The fabric itself felt nice, good weight for a wool blend, but I had to return them for a size that isn't offered above L. Wish the sizing ran a bit more generous.

I read a couple reviews about the pleats not holding and almost skipped this one, but mine in the S have kept their shape through a full work week including a commute by bike. Taupe is a nice muted tone, easy to pair with both black and white tops. Only small thing is the hem sat a touch long so I had it taken up half an inch.

Comfortable wide leg that still looks put together for the office. Bought the M and it's true to size, though the wool blend means dry cleaning only which I didn't realize until I checked the label. Otherwise no complaints, the color is accurate to the listing photos.

The XS fit through the waist but felt roomy at the hip, more of a straight drape than fitted. Fabric is okay, not particularly warm despite being wool blend. Price felt a little high for what arrived, I'd wait for a sale before buying again.

Bought these for my mother as a birthday gift since she loves a wide leg trouser for church and family events. She said the taupe photographs beautifully and the pleats give a nice structured look without being stiff. Went with L based on her usual size and she confirmed the waist has just enough give to sit comfortably after a meal, which she appreciated.

M fits close to true to size, maybe a touch loose at the waistband but nothing a thin belt doesn't fix instantly. What sold me is the fabric weight, heavy enough to hold the pleat shape but not stiff or scratchy against tights. Delivery arrived a couple days later than the estimate, package was a little creased, but the trousers themselves were fine once hung up overnight.
